literal_meaning: ছোট চুনার পুঁটি (small packets or bundles of lime)
figurative_meaning_en: A person with little capital; small-scale trader
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ব্যবসা চুনাপুঁটির মতো, খুব অল্প পুঁজিতে চলে।
গ্রামের চুনাপুঁটির লোকেরা ছোটখাটো ব্যবসা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: His business runs like lime packets, on very little capital.
The small traders in the village are like lime packet sellers, dealing in petty commerce.
history: This idiom originates from the traditional practice of small vendors selling lime (used in construction and betel chewing) in tiny packets, symbolizing low-investment street-level trade in rural or semi-urban Bengal.
note: Synonymous with আদার ব্যাপারী, referring to petty merchants.
